payload.name: Coordinate Agents Through the Shared Context
payload.description: Agents working in one tree read the shared summary first, claim before editing, never edit what another live agent holds, keep write sets apart, and end with a handoff that says what is verified and what is not.

principles.name: The tree is shared
principles.description: Two agents editing one file lose work silently; a claim is cheaper than a merge.

heuristics.condition: a claim is hours old and its owner has no live presence
heuristics.action: report it as stale so the owner or the operator releases it
give each a disjoint write set

decision_rules.name: Summary first
decision_rules.condition: work starts in a shared tree
decision_rules.outcome: read the shared summary of live agents, claims and latest handoffs before anything else

decision_rules.name: Claim before edit
decision_rules.condition: a file is about to be edited
decision_rules.outcome: claim it; a refusal means another live agent holds it, so coordinate; release it when done

decision_rules.name: Share a file by small hunks
decision_rules.condition: two agents must change one file
decision_rules.outcome: make small additive edits, say so in the handoff, and commit only your own hunks

decision_rules.name: Hand off at the end
decision_rules.outcome: leave a note naming the files, what is verified and what is not, the first places to check, and anything uncommitted and why

decision_rules.name: Check the machine before building
decision_rules.condition: a build is about to start
decision_rules.outcome: make sure no other compiler is running and memory is free; the machine is shared and limited

decision_rules.name: Fork only for scoped work
decision_rules.outcome: fork only for well-scoped independent chunks the operator allowed, and verify each result before reporting it
